nodes.name: Schedule — Daily Check
nodes.notes: Runs once daily. Checks for interview slots that have been in 'offered' status for more than 48 hours without a candidate response.

nodes.name: HTTP — Fetch Unconfirmed Slots
nodes.notes: Fetches all interview slots where status='offered' and proposed_start is within 48h OR slot was created 48h+ ago with no confirmation.

nodes.name: IF — Any Pending?
nodes.notes: Only proceed if there are actually unconfirmed slots to remind about.

nodes.name: Split — Each Slot
nodes.notes: Processes each unconfirmed application individually so each gets its own reminder email.

parameters.subject: Reminder: Please select your interview time — {{ $json.job_title }}
parameters.message:
Hi {{ $json.candidate_name }},

Just a quick reminder — we're still waiting for you to select your preferred interview time for the {{ $json.job_title }} position.

Please pick a slot here: {{ $env.APP_BASE_URL }}/interviews/{{ $json.application_id }}/confirm

If you're no longer interested or need different times, please reply to this email.

Best regards,
The Hiring Team

nodes.name: Email — Send Reminder
nodes.notes: Sends a reminder email to the candidate with the same confirm link. Logged to audit_log via the next node.

nodes.name: HTTP — Log Reminder to Audit
nodes.notes: Every reminder is logged to audit_log so recruiters can see exactly when and how many reminders were sent per candidate.

meta.description: HireFlow reminder sub-workflow. Runs daily, checks for unconfirmed interview slots older than 48h, sends reminder emails, logs to audit_log. Import this as a separate workflow in n8n alongside the main recruitment-pipeline workflow.
